  "description": "1. ABOUT BYFAS & THE ROLE\nBYFAS is seeking a Luxury Sales Consultant who serves not only as a revenue generator but as a true Brand Ambassador. In this role, you will connect esteemed clients with our brand heritage, fine craftsmanship, and the artistic spirit of the Maison.\n\n2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES\n• Luxury Client Experience & Sales:\n  o Welcome and deliver an exceptional, tailor-made luxury shopping experience to clients visiting the Maison/Showroom.\n  o Share in-depth knowledge of brand heritage, silk craftsmanship, and artistic value across product categories: Couture, Couture Áo Dài, Ready-to-Wear, Accessories, etc.\n  o Guide clients through the complete journey: Consultation → Fitting → Styling Proposal → Closing → After-sales care.\n\n• Clienteling & CRM:\n  o Build, maintain, and categorize an individual client book (VIP/VVIP, High Potential, Existing, and New Prospects).\n  o Record detailed client profiles (style preferences, measurements, key occasions, budget) to deliver highly personalized styling services.\n  o Foster long-term relationships through proactive post-purchase follow-ups, private previews, and special occasion greetings.\n\n• Order Management & Team Collaboration:\n  o Manage assigned leads across walk-ins, private client lists, social media, events, and management referrals.\n  o Coordinate seamlessly with Design, Atelier (Tailoring), and Production teams to ensure bespoke and made-to-measure orders meet client commitments.\n\n• Brand Representation:\n  o Maintain impeccable grooming, dress-code standards, and luxury etiquette at all times.\n  o Uphold Visual Merchandising standards and ensure strict confidentiality regarding client data and Couture designs.",
  "requirements_text": "Tổng quan — Yêu cầu:\n1 năm kinh nghiệm chuyên môn  Trung cấp trở lên\n\nYêu cầu ứng viên\n* 1–2 years’ experience in luxury fashion / jewelry / hospitality 5★.\n* Excellent communication & client service skills.\n* Stylish, professional presence.\n* English communication (other languages a plus).\n* Passion for fashion, silk, and Vietnamese heritage.\n\nKiến thức ngành\nMay mặc / Thời trang"
